name: How do you heat and cool a garage apartment conversion?
description: Ductless mini-split heat pumps are the most practical solution because they provide independent temperature control without overworking your home's central HVAC

mainEntity.name: How do you heat and cool a garage apartment conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most garage conversions rely on an independent ductless mini-split heat pump rather than tapping into the central system of the main house. Standard household heating and cooling units are sized strictly for the existing home's square footage, meaning pulling air into an unconditioned garage can strain the equipment and cause uneven temperatures. A mini-split provides direct heating and cooling, allows independent thermostat control for the apartment occupant, and avoids pulling garage odors or dust through shared ducts. Adequate wall and ceiling insulation must be installed alongside the unit to maintain steady indoor comfort.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ductless mini-split heat pumps are the most practical solution because they provide independent temperature control without overworking your home's central HVAC system.
